SELECT NVL(MAX(document_id), 0) + 1 FROM documents
INSERT INTO documents(document_id, category, title, content, created_by, created_at, project_id, is_pinned, is_deleted, is_comment, attachment_group_id) VALUES(#{documentId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, #{projectId}, #{isPinned}, 'Q2', #{isComment}, #{attachmentGroupId})
mapper.select: SELECT d.document_id, d.category, d.title, d.content, d.created_by, d.created_at, d.project_id, d.is_pinned, d.is_deleted, d.is_comment, d.attachment_group_id, p.project_name, p.start_date, p.end_date, r.role_name, u.user_name FROM documents d JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = d.project_id LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = d.category JOIN users u ON u.user_id = d.created_by WHERE d.document_id = #{id} AND d.is_deleted='Q2'

SELECT DISTINCT(u.user_name), u.user_id FROM documents d JOIN users u ON d.created_by = u.user_id JOIN projects p ON d.project_id = p.project_id WHERE (p.parent_project_id = #{id} OR d.project_id = #{id} AND u.is_active = 'O1')

SELECT DISTINCT(t.type_name), t.task_type_id FROM documents d JOIN task_types t ON t.task_type_id = d.category JOIN projects p ON d.project_id = p.project_id WHERE (d.project_id = #{id}) AND t.is_active = 'O1'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_comments( document_comment_id, document_id, user_id, content, is_deleted, created_at) VALUES( (SELECT NVL(max(document_comment_id),0)+1 FROM document_comments), #{documentId}, #{userId}, #{content}, 'Q2', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT d.document_comment_id, d.document_id, d.user_id, u.user_name, d.content, d.created_at FROM document_comments d LEFT JOIN users u ON d.user_id = u.user_id WHERE d.document_id = #{id} AND d.is_deleted = 'Q2' ORDER BY d.created_at
